links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT disclosed sources for its urological patient information
links.effect: Chatbot does not disclose its information sources; treatment answers scored 3 of 5 on DISCERN, and all pathologies except BPH scored 4.
links.quote: ChatGPT information should be used with caution since the chatbot does not disclose the sources of information and may contain bias even with simple questions related to the basics of urologic diseases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality and safety of ChatGPT-4 responses to patient-oriented urological disease questions using DISCERN without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
